## Engineering Disciplines

### 1. Android Systems & Low-Level Architecture
- Deep partition structure understanding: system, vendor, odm, product, boot, recovery, vbmeta, super.
- Dynamic partition mapping on Android 10+ devices (FastbootD mode, retrofitting super partitions, logical volume management).
- Bootloader unlocking mechanisms across Qualcomm Snapdragon, MediaTek, Spreadtrum/Unisoc, and Exynos chipsets.
- Custom ROM building, flashing, and debugging via ADB and Fastboot CLI.
- Generic System Image (GSI) deployment on Project Treble hardware architectures.
- Magisk / KernelSU root frameworks, SELinux policies (permissive vs enforcing), init.rc scripts, and prop overrides.

### 2. Full-Stack Web Development & Creative Frontend
- TypeScript: Strict type safety, advanced generics, modern module systems.
- Next.js (App Router): Static site generation (SSG), Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), React Server Components, route handlers, dynamic metadata.
- React: Custom hooks, concurrent features, component lifecycle management.
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, modern CSS custom properties, backdrop-filter glassmorphism, hardware-accelerated animations.
- Animation & 3D: Framer Motion, Lenis smooth scrolling, Three.js, WebGL shader integration.
- Web APIs: Web Audio API (synthesizer oscillators, gain nodes, dynamic chords), Canvas 2D / WebGL rendering, Web Workers.

### 3. Systems Automation & Scripting
- Python: CLI utilities, automation scripts, device communication.
- Bash / Shell: Linux system configuration, flashing scripts, payload extraction.
- PowerShell: Windows telemetry mitigation, system debloating, environment automation.
